topic: K-Stick and the Overconfident Automatic Hand Dryer
hook_text: K-Stick discovers a hand dryer with a mind of its own!
background: Simple public restroom with a sink, wall-mounted hand dryer, and clean tiled wall
main_expression: Confident grin changing into wide-eyed confusion, then an embarrassed smile
main_pose: Standing with both hands under the dryer, leaning back dramatically, then giving a tiny awkward wave
scene_1: K-Stick washes his hands and proudly places them under the automatic dryer as if presenting a magic trick.
scene_2: The dryer blasts air, but only at one hand. K-Stick shifts left and right, trying to catch the invisible air stream.
scene_3: He finally positions both hands perfectly, smiles at the camera, and gives a confident thumbs-up.
twist_ending: The dryer suddenly stops and blows one tiny puff directly at K-Stick's cap, launching it onto his face. He calmly gives the dryer a thumbs-up anyway.
facebook_caption: He defeated the hand dryer... until it attacked his cap! 😂
youtube_description: K-Stick just wanted dry hands, but the automatic hand dryer had its own goofy plan. A quick, family-friendly stickman comedy reel with a surprise cap flip!
image_prompt: A simple 2D cartoon frame featuring K-Stick, a black stickman with a round white face, huge expressive eyes, and a signature red cap, standing in a clean minimal public restroom beside a wall-mounted automatic hand dryer. Bright flat colors, thick clean outlines, simple reusable background, playful family-friendly style, no text, no copyrighted characters.
motion_prompt: Create a fast 15-second 2D stickman animation with three quick beats: K-Stick washes his hands and confidently places them under the automatic dryer; the air stream moves unpredictably as he shuffles side to side with exaggerated confused eyes; he finally poses proudly, then the dryer stops and sends one tiny puff at his red cap, flipping it over his face. End with K-Stick giving an awkward thumbs-up. Use simple squash-and-stretch, quick comedic timing, light whoosh sounds, and a short pop sound for the cap flip.
